name: SH2 Cast - Right (self)
description: The same MSCO_right1-4 art as SH2 Cast - Right, for a fire-and-forget SELF cast resolved to the RIGHT hand. SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 2 is cast_anim_ids.h kSelf.primary; SpellHotbar_CastingSource (0x835) == 1 is the right hand. The clips are byte-distinct copies rather than shared bytes, because OAR's duplicate filter collapses two submods that reference identical bytes (ADR-0017).
